text: The sources do not agree about the 2012 tree-cover loss on this property. Hansen GFC detected about 1.4 ha of tree-cover loss in 2012, but the independent JRC 2020 reference agrees on only 49% of that area. The required agreement threshold is at least 50%. Therefore, the assessment status is contradicted. The MGAP 2021 data indicates that the area of loss was not native forest, but planted forest.
